items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: Well Chip came in later. I had already done two albums, but that was all right.

ctx.x: Well Chip came in later. I had already done two albums, but that was all right. When Chip came in they all wanted to do their own stuff and their own playing, so it was a little strange. A lot of them were not players before they began. For example in the drums

Mickey didn’t, he never played drums before. But they wanted to make him the drummer. So Columbia sends the drums over to his house and where the guys dropped the drums is where he learned to play. So the snare was on the wrong side and the toms were on the wrong side. But that’s the way they set it up and it was three or four weeks every day, every night, he played those drums. When he came to the studio I set up the drums the way I normally would. And he looked at them and he said, “No, I don’t know what to do…
